about: Dialogue track DL-3: each character's own speech bubble (docs/phases/dialogue-track.md, 'Every character has their own bubble'; logic/talk-skins.js, css/talk-skins.css). A speaker id (people, story.json speakers) or a run trainer's class (events.json classes) names a skin; anyone else wears the default. A skin: its shape family (logic/ui-theme.js UI_SHAPE_FAMILIES; a shout or a thought takes its own shape over it), a slant of the frame in degrees, how strongly the bubble tilts (0-2, times the Motion dial), its entrance (pop: the spring; soft: slower and gentler; still: a fade), its blip (voice: the speaker's pitch; typewriter: a key's clack; calm: softer) and its decorations (talk-skins.css draws them).
